posts.title: A Single-Exponential Protocol for Envy-Free Chore Division
A Deterministic Polynomial-Query Protocol for Envy-Free Cake Cutting
posts.description: How do you divide a cake among n people so that nobody prefers someone else’s piece? For two people the answer is ancient: one cuts, the other chooses. For more people the road has been long. Brams and Taylor (1995) gave the first protocol for any number of people, but the number of steps it needs has no upper bound.
